slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
楔子
蓝星
晚上十一点半，林鹤清走在回家的路上，这个城中村是他每天回家的必经之地。
听说是有一户人家死活不同意拆迁，一直没谈拢，只能这样放着了，不过大部分人都已经拿钱走人了，可以算得上是空村。
“你们干什么？放开我！！”一道尖锐的女声从巷子里深处传来。
“我们想干什么？哈哈哈哈，我们不干什么，我们就是想和妹妹亲近亲近，是不是啊兄弟们”，一个猥琐的声音回道。
还有许多道其他声音附和他。
林鹤清不打算冲出去救人，一个是他一个人势单力薄，那里人那么多肯定打不过；另一个是他从小就不擅长打架，长大后学的这两脚猫功夫就是个花架子。
他打算先离开找个角落帮女孩打个报警电话。
他正打算悄悄离开，一个身影就跑了出来，一头撞在他肚子上，女孩发出“哎呦”的声音。
混混们追出来，十分气定神闲。
那帮混混根本有恃无恐，就是故意把她放走然后抓回来，戏弄她呢，女孩却以为自己可以逃掉。
女孩以为有人来救她了，喊道“大哥，帮我报个警，有坏人”，声音又尖锐又急切。
林鹤清恨不得捂住她的嘴，只能先拉住她的手，带她逃跑。
里面的混混听见这声音，一伙人就要围过来。
“还敢报警，给我抓住他们”，那人挥了挥手，自以为很帅的样子。
林鹤清和女孩使劲跑着，后面这些小混混在后面追，眼看就要离开城中村了，林鹤清一直关注后面的人离得有多近，没注意女孩。
女孩回头，使劲一推林鹤清，“对不起了”，然后自己跑了。
正在奔跑中的人，一点点碰撞都容易失去平衡，何况是这个用力的推搡。
“啊”，林鹤清一下子就向后摔倒了，被后面的人给抓住了。

“好啊，你小子，英雄救美啊”，然后把他抓回城中村的中间，十几个人围着他，让他想跑也跑不了。
“你们别想做坏事，我已经报警了，警察马上就到。”林鹤清被女孩背刺，只能先用缓兵之计。
“给我打”，混混头头发话了，下面的小弟也气气愤到手的女孩没了，心里带着气，下手也没个轻重。
林鹤清也不能站着挨打，用双手格挡，尽可能的用自己学的跆拳道知识回击。
但是发现，双拳难敌四手，敌人实在太多了，打不过，就抱紧脑袋，软弱起来，躲在墙角减少伤害。
林鹤清感到自己的头好晕，有什么东西从脑袋上流下来，原来是自己被推倒在地上，流下来的是自己的血。
content_en:
wedge
blue star
At 11:30 p.m., Lin Heqing was walking home. This village in the city was the place he must pass every day when he went home.
I heard that one family disagreed with the demolition and had never reached an agreement, so they had to leave it alone. However, most of the people had already taken their money and left, so it could be considered an empty village.
"What are you doing? Let me go!!" A sharp female voice came from deep in the alley.
"What do we want to do? Hahahaha, we don't do anything, we just want to be close to our sister, don't you, brothers?" a lewd voice replied.
Many other voices echoed him.
Lin Heqing didn't plan to rush out to save people. One was that he was weak alone and there were so many people there and he would definitely not be able to defeat them. The other was that he had not been good at fighting since he was a child, and the two-legged cat kung fu he learned when he grew up was just a show.
He planned to leave first and find a corner to help the girl make a call to the police.
Just as he was about to leave quietly, a figure ran out and bumped into his stomach. The girl made an "ouch" sound.
The gangsters chased them out, very calm and relaxed.
Those gangsters were so confident that they deliberately let her go and then caught her back to tease her, but the girl thought she could escape.
The girl thought someone was coming to save her and shouted, "Brother, call the police for me, there are bad guys", her voice was sharp and urgent.
Lin Heqing wanted to cover her mouth, so he could only hold her hand and lead her away.
When the gangster inside heard the sound, a group of people came around.
"How dare you call the police and catch them?" The man waved his hand, thinking he was very handsome.
Lin Heqing and the girl ran as hard as they could, with the gangsters chasing after them. They were about to leave the village in the city. Lin Heqing kept paying attention to how close the people behind him were, and did not pay attention to the girl.
The girl turned around, pushed Lin Heqing hard, said, "I'm sorry," and then ran away.
A person who is running can easily lose his balance at the slightest collision, let alone this forceful push.
"Ah", Lin Heqing fell backwards and was caught by the person behind him.
"Okay, you boy, a hero saves a beautiful girl." Then he was captured back to the middle of the village in the city. More than a dozen people surrounded him, making it impossible for him to run away even if he wanted to.
"Don't do anything bad. I've called the police. The police will be here soon." Lin Heqing was stabbed in the back by the girl, so he could only use a delaying tactic first.
"Hit me," the gangster leader said, and the younger brother below was also angry that the girl he had obtained was gone. He was angry and didn't think it was a serious move.
Lin Heqing couldn't stand and take a beating, so he blocked with both hands and tried his best to use his Taekwondo knowledge to fight back.
But I found that it was difficult for two fists to defeat four hands. There were too many enemies and I couldn't defeat them, so I hugged my head tightly, became weak, and hid in the corner to reduce the damage.
Lin Heqing felt dizzy, and something was flowing from his head. It turned out that he was pushed to the ground, and what was flowing down was his own blood.
